My moves of the kind "Arrow based" have their power multiplied by 1.3 (1.3 = 30% stronger).
My moves that are arrow moves never miss. Every setting you fill in must match.
My moves that are ball and bomb moves never miss. Every setting you fill in must match.
When my hit is a critical hit, the damage formula uses whichever is lower, the foe's Defense or Sp. Def. Example: a foe with 100 Defense and 60 Sp. Def takes a physical crit as if it had 60.
The foe's boosts and drops to Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, Accuracy, Evasion are treated as zero. Example: a foe at +6 Attack hits me as if it were at +0.

My moves of the kind "Air based" have their power multiplied by 1.3 (1.3 = 30% stronger).
I take no damage that does not come straight from a move: poison, burn, weather, hazards, recoil and Rough Skin style damage. Example: Magic Guard.

legacyClosures.gate: The filter tests the move's own property bit (move.hasFlag) and the holder's full HP. The library atom move.flag asks doesFlagEffectApply, which also counts flags that abilities inject, so it is not the same predicate; one gate holds one binding. Needs an atom for the plain move property (R-B11-13).
